description: Create, update, or remove a bridge interface on a MikroTik router. Idempotent: create returns already_exists if a bridge with the same name (and the requested vlanFiltering) exists, update returns no_change when nothing differs. update sets vlanFiltering, comment, disabled. Enabling vlanFiltering is the classic lock-out: before turning it on, verify the management VLAN, that the bridge itself is listed as tagged in list_bridge_vlans for every VLAN interface on the bridge, and that port PVIDs (list_bridge_ports) put the management port in the VLAN that reaches the router's address. Configure the VLAN table (manage_bridge_vlan) and PVIDs (manage_bridge_port) first and enable filtering last; dry-run first and read the warnings.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

disabled.description: Whether the bridge is disabled (create: defaults to false; update: unchanged when omitted)

name.description: Bridge interface name, taken verbatim for update/remove; create accepts letters, digits, dot, hyphen, underscore, up to 64 chars

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

vlanFiltering.description: Turn bridge VLAN filtering on or off (create/update). Enabling it on a bridge that carries the management address can lock you out; see the tool description.

name: manage_bridge
title: Manage Bridge Interface
